bundle.shortDescription: Free PC care: clean, scan, organize. Chipping in is optional.
bundle.longDescription: Sweepwise cleans junk, checks your protection, finds duplicates and big forgotten files, maps your drive and (optionally, with your own AI key) helps organize your folders. It changes nothing personal without your OK, approved changes can be undone except uninstalls and app updates, and nothing is ever collected.
